name: Semantic Table Obfuscation
description: Replaces the recognizable algebraic polynomial `(M_u * M_v) - M_u - M_v` with a logically equivalent piecewise condition based on the sum of the multipliers. This prevents models from using symbolic algebra to pattern-match the underlying independent set reduction, forcing them to manually deduce that a total score of -m requires avoiding any pair summing to 4.
